workarounds.symptom: Locked server environments lose explicit-index sources when a uv index variable is set
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: keep explicit-index sources in the uv mirror sync. Target files: nemo_gym/server_runtime/supervisor/_locked_env.py, tests/unit_tests/server_runtime/supervisor/test_locked_env.py. When a uv index variable is set, `sync_environment` takes the `_sync_from_mirror` path. `uv export` drops the lock's per-package index sources, so packages pinned to an explicit index (e.g. `torch==2.6.0+cpu`) are looked up on the caller's indexes and fail to install. (Ref: https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Gym/pull/6355)

workarounds.symptom: [NVBug 6805516] Replace load_dataset with hf_hub_download in IF/reasoning_gym prepare
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(environments): copy the raw JSONL in instruction_following and reasoning_gym prepare. Target files: environments/instruction_following/prepare.py, environments/reasoning_gym/prepare.py, tests/unit_tests/test_jsonl_environment_prepare.py. `python environments/instruction_following/prepare.py` and `python environments/reasoning_gym/prepare.py`, the README steps that download each environment's training data, now write the published file. Before this change, both crashed inside Arrow before writing anything. (Ref: https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Gym/pull/5092)
